notes.title: Update Notes 0.0.38
notes.content:
This is a major update in how Powerplay RTS is played
[list]
[*] Global resource management via a Factorio-style inventory + crafting panel
[*] All players actions can be done manually
[*] Automation is necessary for scale
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Global resource management via a Factorio-style inventory + crafting panel
[*] All players actions can be done manually

notes.title: Update Notes 0.0.37
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Support multiple fog of war modes (standard, explored, revealed)
[*] Major scripting API additions (can control pretty much everything)
[*] New tutorial, completely made using the scripting system
[*] New building system (build if a depot in proximity has construction material)
[*] HUD health section wip
[*] Support environment deadwood 
[*] Major frustum optim, only rendering sectors within the camera view
[*] Terrain stamps also copy resources and buildings
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 0.0.35
notes.content:
[h2]New units[/h2]
[list]
[*] Air Unit: The Fighter
[*] Air Unit: The Chinook Transport
[*] Sea Unit: The Corvette
[*] Sea Unit: The U-boat  submarine
[/list]

[h2]Scripting[/h2]
[list]
[*] Support a global Map script
[*] Support per-unit and per-building scripts
[*] Show cell coordinates indicator in edit mode. Useful to make unit:move({ x=x, y=y }) commands
[/list]

[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Conveyor placement snaps to closest port on building
[*] All air units have a shadow indicator including when flying over ocean
[*] Can change the brush size when painting liquid resources or ocean
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add tank cannon shake when shooting
[*] Add fighter attack move
[*] New grid-based pathfinding system, faster and more stable
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 0.0.27
notes.content:
[h1]Major change to the production system[/h1]
[list]
[*] Factories produce output into their reserves and can produce actively without being connected to other buildings.
[*] All building interactions are consistent and standardized. Any resource can be deposited and extracted from any building.
[*] The only thing special about Depots is that they have a much bigger storage capacity than other buildings
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix units getting stuck while collecting resources
[*] Support double-clicking in the main menu game list
[/list]

[*] All building interactions are consistent and standardized. Any resource can be deposited and extracted from any building.
[*] The only thing special about Depots is that they have a much bigger storage capacity than other buildings

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] The depot now clearly indicates the inventory capacity
[*] Any building that has an inventory can call for idle workers to come and pick it up
[*] Units now have a stop action command, actionable via the UI or a shortcut (S)
[*] The resource generation is more even and ensures no soft lock is possible
[*] New Indication on the buildings that have no space to eject an output
[/olist]
